deities.name: The Wayfarer Lantern
deities.title: Patron of Roads & Watchful Eyes
deities.description: Honored by scouts and travelers at wayside shrines for steady footing and clear sight on perilous roads.
deities.blessings: Boosts Perception, travel resilience, and shrine recovery.

deities.name: The Forge Hearth
deities.title: Patron of Craft & Enduring Steel
deities.description: Invoked by artisans on the Ember Terrace so raw ore and wild herbs yield dependable gear.
deities.blessings: Favors crafting checks and hearth-side recovery.
